blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ emergency response system could serve as a blueprint for similar services in Cambodia and Vietnam, as the US-based company behind the country’s Unified 911 system looks to expand its operations across Southeast Asia. Next Generation Advanced (NGA) 911 said government officials from both countries had expressed interest in the Philippines’ experience in modernizing its emergency response system.
